sentences.en: Reinvestment risk is another risk associated with Treasury bonds.

sentences.en: They also have all the information on the funding opportunities created by the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act that relate to home solar kits.

sentences.en: In response to the economic difficulties of the recession, the American Recovery and Reinvestment Tax Act of 2009 allowed for tax credits on both large and small home improvement projects.

sentences.en: This site also lists a number of jobs related to the Recovery and Reinvestment Act actions that the President enacted.

sentences.en: Thanks to the 2009 American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (ARRA), job searching for sustainable careers has become much easier.

sentences.en: It also helps brokers fulfill their responsibilities under the Community Reinvestment Act (CRA).

sentences.en: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009 - This program is designed to help first time home buyers who are having trouble finding the funds for a down payment on a new home.

sentences.en: In 2009, President Obama signed the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009 into law.
